# FynHelp

> India's AI CFO platform. Real-time financial intelligence for startups and SMEs — cash flow, runway, GST compliance, and revenue, powered by CFO Fynny.

FynHelp is a virtual-CFO SaaS built for Indian small and mid-size businesses. The product surfaces liquidity, revenue, cost, GST and tax, governance, HR, and investor-ready metrics in a single intelligence cockpit, with an AI assistant (Fynny) that answers finance questions in plain English.
